chapters: Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Josuee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch maa'n guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Kananeos.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; gio ba' gu Judaa guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' dhagia' gu oidha' gu noobh.

Ba' jix aa' gu Judaa gu Simeoon xibhɨk; gio ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan gu Kananeo tu' gio jix duu bɨndak guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Simeoon ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Judaa gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh gu Kananeo gu Pereseo; gio ba' jix duu gu Besek mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Adoni-besek gu Besek guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu Kananeo gu Pereseo.
Gu' gu' gu Adoni-besek guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' bhiadat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix duu gu noobh tɨɨt.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Adoni-besek; gio ba' gu Setenta gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu gu noobh tɨɨt guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat iigɨsda' bɨtaa'n meesa; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jerusalem pai' jix koi.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu tai kiicham.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Kananeo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gɨ' kavɨk saagi'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Judaa bhaan gu Kananeo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ebroon guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga va'k gu Kîriat-arba; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu Sesai gu Aiman gu Talmai.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñka' gu Debir va'k guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Kîriat-seper.
Ba' jix aa' gu Kaleb; na guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Kîriat-seper guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Axa mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Otoniel gu mar gu Kenes xibhɨk jix ali' gu Kaleb; gio ba' jix maa gu Axa mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu taat yooxi'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga buur gu Kaleb jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; na jix maa gu oidha' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gio suudai' buusñi gu suudai'; jano' ba' gu Kaleb jix maa suudai' buusñi jiix suudai' buusñi guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kineo jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kiicham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Judaa oidha' jix gaki gu Judaa saagi'ñ gu Arad; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Judaa xibhɨk gu Simeoon tu' jix duu gu Kananeo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Sepat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham gu orma.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu Judaa gu Gasa bɨɨx gu oidha' gu Askaloon bɨɨx gu oidha' gu Ekroon bɨɨx pai'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Judaa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gɨ' kavɨk; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oi'ñka' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ko'kmarak guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu ebroon gu Kaleb na ja'p gu Moisees ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik gu ma'nkam gu Anak.

Gu' gu' gu Jebuseo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jerusalem cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Jebuseo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Jerusalem bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' gio gu vaak gu Josee guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Bet-el; gio ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Josee jix dhaas guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Bet-el kiicham va'k guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu tasi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chio'ñ busaak kiicham gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' ba'k kiicham chulhiiñchuda' bɨndak xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ba'k kiicham tu' jix duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii; gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu jum duu gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu eteos kiicham jup tɨɨt gu tasi'; gio ba' dhi' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu Tampoko gu Manasees guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Bet-sean tu' taañpu' tu' gu Taanak taañpu' tu' gu Dor taañpu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Ibleam taañpu' tu' oi'ñka' gu Megiddo taañpu'; gu' gu Kananeo guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na pai' dhuuk gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ tu' na jix kavɨk gu Kananeo bopxi'ñ gu' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Epraim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Kananeo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Geser; gio ba' va'k guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Kananeo tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Geser.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Sabuloon guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oi'ñka' gu Kîtron oi'ñka' gu Naalol; gu' gu Kananeo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Aser guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oi'ñka' gu Akô oi'ñka' gu Sidoon gu Alab gu Aksib gu elba gu Apek gu Reod.
Jano' ba' va'k guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Aser tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kananeos oi'ñka' gu oidha'; na gu' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Neptalii guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oi'ñka' gu Bet-semes oi'ñka' gu Bet-anat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kananeos oi'ñka' gu oidha'; gu' jix bɨɨx duu bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Bet-semes guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Bet-anat.
Jano' ba' gu Amorreos guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk; na cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Amorreo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu kavɨk gu eres gu Ajaloon gu Saalbiin; gu' na ja'p gu novɨ gu vaak gu Josee jix bhɨɨ tu' na jix kavɨk jix duu bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Amorreo ka't dɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Akrabim dɨr gu jodai jiix.

Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ gu Gilgal gu Bokîm; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Ejipto guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu oidha' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tattat; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mɨɨjidha' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi'.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' gio tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Bokîm; gio ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Josuee ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios maa'n gu maa'nkar na ba' bia'ka'.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Josuee bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios daraa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr gu Josuee guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat buupui guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ buimɨi gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chamaam mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Timnat-sera gu kavɨk gu Epraim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu kavɨk gu Gaas.

Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr jix duu ka't gio guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx tattat; gio ba' jix búup mi' dhɨr jix duu cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu duukam ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Baales.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios tattat ka't jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam mi'p xikoolh o'lhia; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios o'lhia gu Baal gu Astarot.

Jano' ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Israeel do'ñcho gu noobh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu noobh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios xikoolh; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan na ba' cham bhai' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu novɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ o'lhia; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa xoi'kam jootom gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tattat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham jix duu.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx jir bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mii' dhɨr jir bɨx bhai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kuiñcha guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Gu' gu' vaak jodai jir bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tattat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' tu duu tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn buimɨi tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Israeel; na gu' dhi' gu ja'tkam bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tattat cham dhu'npi'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vupui bhaan matgɨm guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Josuee na pai' dhuuk jix koi.

Na ba' na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' gu Israeel tu' nukadham gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ja'p tattat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' do'ñcho gu novɨ gu Josuee.

Jano' ba' dhi' chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx gu Israeel bɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Kanaan.

Na ba' na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' tu jiim bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jum duu va'k cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam chiñia' gu Pilisteos bɨx gu Kananeos gu Sidonios gu ebeos oi'ñka' gu kavɨk gu Liibano; gio ba' dɨr gu kavɨk gu Baal-ermoon bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu amat.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Israeel na ba' maachim tu' tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tattat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oi'ñka' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kananeos gu eteos gu Amorreos gu Pereseos gu ebeos gu Jebuseos.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ jix maa ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Baales duiñxim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu noobh gu Kusan-risataim gu gɨ'kora' gu Mesopotamia; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Kusan-risataim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ boosolh gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr maachim gu Otoniel gu mar gu Kenes xibhɨk jix ali' gu Kaleb.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel jix buus guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu novɨ gu Kusan-risataim gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu novɨ bhaan gu Kusan-risataim.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ gu oidha' oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' jix koi gu Otoniel gu mar gu Kenes.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Egloon gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab bhaan gu Israeel na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ baidhak gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Amalek ka't tu' naaka'n gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ kiicham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Egloon gu gɨ'kora' gu Moabitas mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ boosolh gu Aod gu mar gu Gera gu Benjamita ga'ra' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu novɨ jix duu; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mɨjɨ bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Egloon gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab.

Jano' ba' gu Aod ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gook mu'muk novɨ maa'nkar tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨtaa'n jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Egloon gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab; gio ba' ka't gu Egloon gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dɨr duiñxim gu Gilgal; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ no'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' moor bɨɨx bɨx vupui bhaan mi'p.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Aod ka't daakat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' gu Aod jix aa'; mi' dhɨr no'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu'; jano' ba' jix búup guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Gu' gu' gu Aod guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu novɨ o'nsop jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vook.

Jano' ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ chɨbiapui gio bhaan jajar guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jajar cham jix buusñi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vook; gio ba' jix buus guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gamai' gu Aod naadat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tɨɨtɨs tu duukam ñɨi'ñ kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gui'p; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' dhaibu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' jix koi.
Gu' gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Aod guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhɨi duiñxim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Seirat.

Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't kia'mi'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Moabitas gu noobh; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jordaan gu Moab cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu gu Moabitas na ja'p mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ bɨx jix kavɨk bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu chio'ñ.

Na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Moab guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ gu Israeel; gio ba' jix utu'ñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Samgar gu mar gu Anat naaka'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ gu Pilisteos bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaakax; gio ba' gio guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Aod.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu novɨ gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Kanaan jix gɨ'kora' gu Asor; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Siisara guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu aroset gu Gentes.

Na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel gu u'vɨ gu Deebora guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu u'vɨ gu Lapidot.
Jano' ba' gu Deebora guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨtaa'n gu novɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Rama gu Bet-el gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' bhañ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Barak gu mar gu Abinoam gu Kedes gu Neptalii; gio ba' cham tu' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bham; mi' dhɨr tu' gu vupui gu ja'tkam gu kavɨk gu Tabor guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨndak mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii gu ma'nkam gu Sabuloon.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Kisoon gu Siisara guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jabiin bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham kapbhai' gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu Barak jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' jix duu; gu' tu' cham tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham jix duu.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duu bɨndak; gu' cham ka't nɨidhat gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na gu' gu novɨ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios gu Siisara; gio ba' kɨkbo gu Deebora ka't bɨɨx gu Barak gu Kedes.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Barak gu Sabuloon gu Neptalii gu Kedes jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Deebora jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu eber gu Kineo gu ma'nkam gu obab jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Kineos guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vaak zel bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Saananim ju'ñdharan gu Kedes.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Siisara na ja'p gu Barak gu mar gu Abinoam ka't tu jiim gu kavɨk gu Tabor.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Siisara bɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't dɨr gu aroset gu Gentes bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Kisoon.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Deebora gu Barak; gio ba' bamii'; na gu' dhi' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu Siisara gu noobh; jano' ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan tu' gu Barak jix dhaav gu kavɨk gu Tabor mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Siisara bɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii vupui bhaan gu Barak; gio ba' gu Siisara jix dhaav guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tɨɨt.

Gu' gu' gu Barak chɨ'ɨɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka'm gu aroset gu Gentes bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Siisara guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii bɨɨx ka'm cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu Siisara guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tɨɨt vaak zel gu Jael gu u'vɨ gu eber gu Kineo; na gu' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Asor gu vaak gu eber gu Kineo.

Ba' jix aa' gamai' gu Jael guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Siisara; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam choo'n; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va vaak zel jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ i'i guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu suudai' no'ñ tu jiim; mi' dhɨr jix kupi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bii'm jix maa i'i guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ki'ñgob vaak zel tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn daraibu' tu' tu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch oi'ñdha' tu' tu ñi'ook cham.

Jano' ba' gu Jael gu u'vɨ gu eber jix bhɨɨ dhi' vaak zel guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu novɨ suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Barak gu Siisara gu Jael jix buus jix duu; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui pai' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Siisara guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix koi bɨɨx dhi' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Kanaan vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel kua'da' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix duu bhaan gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Kanaan bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jiiñ gu Deebora bɨɨx gu Barak gu mar gu Abinoam bham.
Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Israeel na gu' gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat aagak guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook chiñia' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Seir gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios yooxi' gu Edom gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨbaa'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Sinaii vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Samgar gu mar gu Anat gu tanoolh gu Jael guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix duu.

Jano' ba' taañpu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu Deebora guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu naan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat xixiibkam gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't kiki'ñgob; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ oo'm mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chiñia' gu Israeel bɨɨx jix bhai' aagak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios buur chooto guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ñi'ook na jir bhai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨroon u'u gat tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' na jir bhai' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel; gio ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios kiki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' gu Despierta guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Deebora; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhai' ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bamii' gu Barak guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar gu Abinoam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ja'tkam jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu Epraim jix buus tatk bhaan gu Amalek bhaan tu' gu Benjamiin bhaan gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Makîr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam chiñia' gu Sabuloon gu tas guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' chiñia' gio gu Issakâr jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx gu Deebora; gio ba' na ja'p gu Issakâr gio gu Barak jix dhaas tɨɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Rubeen ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Rubeen jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu Dan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim juruuñ ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Mantuubose gu Aser guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Sabuloon guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' koi'm gu Neptalii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam yooxi'.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu gɨ'kora' gu Kanaan gu Taanak ju'ñdharan gu suudai' gu Megiddo gu' cham bhɨɨk tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tuumiñ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' gu si'avag dɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Siisara.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhi'ñbak gu Kisoon guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhi'ñbak gu Kisoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Meros nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na gu' cham tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ gu Jael gu u'vɨ gu eber gu Kineo; gio ba' bhaan gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't vaak zel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu suudai' jix maa bii'm; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ dhi' kɨɨ'n guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Siisara naaka'n mo'o guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨɨt guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨɨt guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na pai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix koi.

Jano' ba' gu naan gu Siisara guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jiiñak tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham jupaabkamu'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gaagam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gook; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' gu Siisara guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't na ja'p gu tas na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' jix utu'ñ oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh gu Madiaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu Madiaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha gu Madianitas jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu kakkavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix kavɨk.
Na gu' na ja'p gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Madianitas gu Amalekitas guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' bhaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Gasa; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jugi gu Israeel tu' kakneer tu' gu vaakax tu' buur.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ aajidha' bɨɨx vaak zel jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' tu' jix ai; gio ba' aajidha' gu oidha' na ba' jix duu.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Madianitas; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel a'lhiok duuñ gu Jawatan Dios kuiñcha gu Madianitas.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Ejipto guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak juantu'n.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu novɨ gu Egipkios gu novɨ bɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' gu Yo guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu Amorreos gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix daa bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Opra ka't gu Joas gu Abieserita; gio ba' gu mar gu Gedeoon ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tiriik guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Madianitas.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Gedeoon jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx no'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' daam bɨx dhi' duukat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kɨɨ'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tattat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bham; mi' dhɨr cham jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu Madianitas.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx dhi' gu kavɨk u'ua'tɨda' gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Madianitas; mi' dhɨr cham tu' jootsa' tu'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim no'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Israeel gu Miren ja'tkam vaak gampai' gu Manasees tu' jix ali' gu vaak gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨndak guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Madianitas na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Yo tu' soi'ñ tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ nɨi'ñchudat tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx ka'm tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Yo guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Gedeoon guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn chiiw gu takarui' cham jabka' gu Epa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' jix dhaas gu chuukug guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨtaa'n mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu chuukug gu takarui' cham jabka' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan dhi' jodai kavɨk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr jix duu.

Jano' ba' jix duu nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ga'ra' gu novɨ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chuukug gu takarui' cham jabka'; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tai jodai kavɨk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chuukug gu takarui' cham jabka'; mi' dhɨr nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Gedeoon ka't nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios buupui nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam choo'n cham koi.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Gedeoon jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt gu Jeobaa-salom; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Opra gu Abieseritas.

Ba' jix aa' ka't gu tukaa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu taat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal gu taat juraa'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gio guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ju'ñdharan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ pai' jix duu; gio ba' dhaagɨk gook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan gu u'u guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Gedeoon jix bhɨɨ mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ tu duukam tu' jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu jiim gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ja'tkam vaak gu taat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ kiicham jix duu gu tukaa'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu xibh na pai' dhuuk kiicham jix búup guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ju'ñdharan ka't maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan mii' dhɨr gook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' chɨkka tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' tu jiim gui'p; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu mar gu Joas tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ kiicham gui'p gu Joas.

Na gu' jix buusñi mai' gu mar na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ju'ñdharan ka't.

Jano' ba' gu Joas jix aa' bɨx mi'p ju'ñdharan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Baal dodhia' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Kualkuiera guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu xibh; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jup tɨɨt gu Gedeoon gu Jerobaal; na gu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Baal bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Madianitas gu Amalekitas guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jum daa'ñ bhɨi guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jesreel.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Gedeoon na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't dhaa guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Abieser jum daa'ñ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bhañ jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Manasees gio jum daa'ñ bɨɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhañ jix duu gu Aser gu Sabuloon gu Neptalii moor jix ai.
Ba' jix aa' gu Gedeoon gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ na ja'p tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix gaki bɨx gu oidha' jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ na ja'p tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't; na gu' na ja'p jix búup gu xibh guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix buusñi guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vaaso jix bhuup gu suudai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Gedeoon gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu ñi'ook dhi' tu jiim; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jano' tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx gu oidha' juruuñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh gu Jerobaal gu Gedeoon bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu arod; gio ba' ga'ra' yooxi' gu Madianitas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn baasɨ'n guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu More guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gedeoon; gio ba' gu ja'tkam bɨndak jix jai' na ba' tu' jix maa gu Madianitas gu novɨ; na gu' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel bhaan tu' bham; jano' ba' gu novɨ tu' dodhia'.

Jano' ba' gu vupui jano' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ja'tkam bham; na guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dɨr gu kavɨk gu Galaad; mi' dhɨr suulh gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gedeoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix jai' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu suudai' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' bɨndak guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨndak; gu' no'x tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' dhi' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨndak tu jiim cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ja'tkam gu suudai'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Gedeoon; mi' dhɨr no'x guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu suudai' bɨɨx nɨɨn na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gagai' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dɨlhkob; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam no'x guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan kɨkbok na ba' i'i.

Jano' ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu suudai' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx gu novɨ gu chin vaik gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan kɨkbok na ba' i'i gu suudai'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gedeoon; gio ba' bɨɨx dhi' ja'tkam vaik gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu suudai' dodhia' kapbhai' gu Madianitas gu noobh; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n pai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' gu ja'tkam gu noobh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhañ bɨx gu Israelitas maa'n vaak zel guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mii' dhɨr ja'tkam vaik gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' ga'ra' yooxi' gu Madiaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bamii' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn yooxi'; na gu' tu' dhagia' gu noobh.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa choo'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' bɨɨx gu Para jix duu yooxi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' gu noobh guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi'; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav bɨɨx gu Para jix duu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ka't yooxi'.

Jano' ba' gu Madiaan gu Amalek bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ mi'p guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix ai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ja'p oo' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Gedeoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam duiñchu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bham; gio ba' gu Miren tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; na guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu takarui' kai' vaas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm yooxi' gu Madiaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaak zel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan jiix guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vaak zel guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' duiñchu'; gio ba' dhi' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu kuchii gu Gedeoon gu mar gu Joas gu chio'ñ gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu noobh gu Madianitas bɨɨx bɨx yooxi'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Gedeoon jix kai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Israeel jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' yooxi' gu Madiaan gu noobh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vaik gu chichio'ñ vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix maa maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu noobh tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gɨ'kora' ja'tkam yooxi' na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' tu' kuichdha' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx no'm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kuichdha' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ xikoolh bɨx yooxi' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios gu Gedeoon.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Gedeoon guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baidhak gɨ'kora' ja'tkam yooxi' ba'k tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu noobh.

Jano' ba' vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu noobh guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ a'aa' bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' gu kuchii gu Jawatan Dios gu Gedeoon.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ yooxi'; gio ba' bɨx yooxi' ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jiboi'ññor guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Gu' gu' vaik guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu kuchii maa'n bhaan duiñchu' bɨx yooxi'; mi' dhɨr ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-sitta bhaan gu Kerera bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Abel-meola gu Tabbat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel gu Neptalii gu Aser bɨx gu Manasees bhiadat gu Madianitas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gio bhañ jix duu bɨx gu kavɨk gu Epraim bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Madianitas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-bara gu Jordaan; mi' dhɨr tɨtda:―Aañ bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Epraim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu suudai' gu Bet-bara gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gook chiñia' gu Madianitas gu Oreb gu Seeb; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Oreb jodai kavɨk gu Oreb gu Seeb guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Seeb; mi' dhɨr bhiadat gu Madianitas aichdhak ɨɨbhidham gu Oreb gu Seeb gu Gedeoon baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' gu Epraim gui'p; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx no'ch cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Madiaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' jano' na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Epraim tutkɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Abieser.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu noobh gu Oreb gu Seeb chiñia' gu Madiaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Gedeoon gu Jordaan na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ baidhak guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sukkot; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhɨt gu chin gu takarui'; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Seba gu Salmunna gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Sukkot tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu novɨ gu Seba gu Salmunna gu novɨ na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam no'ch guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu takarui' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Gedeoon; na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' dhagia' gu novɨ gu Seba gu Salmunna tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu chuukug bɨɨx jo'ii' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oidha' jix gaki.
Ba' jix aa' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Penuel gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Penuel tu ñi'ook na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Sukkot.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Penuel bham; na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhai'x i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ dhi' bhi'ñbak.

Jano' ba' gu Seba gu Salmunna mi'p gu Karkor bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ja'p guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx yooxi' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' koko'kam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii.
Na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Gedeoon bhaan oi'ñka' vaak zel baasɨ'n guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Noba gu Jogbea naaka'n yooxi' na gu' ka't ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Seba gu Salmunna chɨ'ɨɨk; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan gu Seba gu Salmunna guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu Gedeoon gu mar gu Joas guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ va'k gu tas guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Sukkot tu ñi'ook jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak gu ñi'ook gu Sukkot daraa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kɨɨv gu chio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' baakɨk gu Sukkot; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Seba gu Salmunna bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bham; mi' dhɨr tu' gu novɨ gu Seba gu Salmunna gu novɨ na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ no'ch gu takarui' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ daraa kiicham jo'ii' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx gu Sukkot.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhi'ñbak gu Penuel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kiicham.

Ba' jix aa' gu Seba gu Salmunna; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chichio'ñ ko'kmarak mii' dhɨr ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Tabor tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu naan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' tu' cham kooda'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeter maa'nkam mar; gio ba' bamii' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii na gu' ga'ra' choo'n; na guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Seba gu Salmunna; gio ba' bamii' tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; na gu' na ja'p gu chio'ñ tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; jano' ba' gu Gedeoon jix búup guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Seba gu Salmunna; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix ai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baakux.
Jano' ba' gu Israelitas gui'p gu Gedeoon; gio ba' tu' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan tu' gu mar gu ja'tkam; na gu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ gu Madiaan.
Gu' gu' gu Gedeoon jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' gu mar aapi'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Gedeoon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ maa'n jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix uam jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Ismaelitas; jano' ba'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhai' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix uam jodai; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jajannulhi'ñ ñakaabma' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan cham tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix ai baakux.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Gedeoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ nukadham kiicham gu Opra; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mii' dhɨr pai'; mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Gedeoon gu vaak.

Jano' ba' ka't jix duu gu Madiaan vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix búup mo'o; gio ba' jix utu'ñ gu oidha' oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tanoolh gu Gedeoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jerobaal gu mar gu Joas ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaak.
Na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Gedeoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam moor guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mumua'da' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu Sikêm gio guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar; gio ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Abimelek.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Gedeoon gu mar gu Joas jix bhai' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tukga'n gu taat gu Joas gu Opra gu Abieseritas.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix koi gu Gedeoon gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Baales jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios gu Baal-berit.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios xikoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu vaak gu Jerobaal gu Gedeoon jurtu'nka' bɨx xoi'kam ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Pueese gu Abimelek gu mar gu Jerobaal gu Sikêm gu ja'tkam gu naan bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu vaak gu taat gu naan bham.

Jano' ba' tu' soi'ñ tu ñi'ook maatɨt bɨx gu Sikêm; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim namki' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tutkɨ jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Jerobaal; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' gu chio'ñ gu Akordaos tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim o'o gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam gu naan maatɨt bɨx gu Sikêm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Abimelek na gu' am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal-berit bɨɨx gu Abimelek guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhiadat.

Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu vaak gu taat gu Opra guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Jerobaal guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ bhaan gu jodai; gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jotam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix ali' gu mar gu Jerobaal guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx gu Sikêm bɨɨx bɨx gu vaak gu Millo jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Abimelek guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' mia'n guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't gu Sikêm.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p tu ñi'ook gu Jotam ka't jix dhaas guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk gu Gerisim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ gu Sikêm; na gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu u'u guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gui'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' gu Reina bhaan no'ch.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix aa'; gio ba' no'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha gu Jawatan Dios gu chichio'ñ nɨidhat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix gɨ' bhaan gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu u'u iigɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix aa' iigɨx; gio ba' no'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu i'bhɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix gɨ' bhaan gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu u'u guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan no'ch.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix aa'; gio ba' no'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix gɨ' bhaan gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gui'p jano' ba' bɨx gu u'u guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan no'ch.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix aa' gu u'u; gio ba' tu' tu'r guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨtaa'n ɨkgiga'n; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu tai guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Liibano.

Jano' ba' jano' tu' bɨɨx tu'r bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Abimelek tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam xoi'kam bɨɨx gu Jerobaal bɨɨx gu vaak tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jurtu'nka' tu duukam gu noobh.

Jano' ba' gu taat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm u'ua'tɨda' gu novɨ gu Madiaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu vaak gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ bhaan gu jodai; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Sikêm gu Abimelek gu mar guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na gu' xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx tu'r bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx gu Jerobaal bɨɨx gu vaak guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abimelek guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tai guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Abimelek guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Sikêm gu vaak gu Millo; gio ba' gu tai guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Sikêm gu vaak gu Millo guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Abimelek.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jotam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ka't gu Beer juruuñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kuiñcha gu Abimelek xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Abimelek ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu Israeel vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Abimelek gu chichio'ñ gu Sikêm; na gu Sikêm jix búup bhaan gu Abimelek.

Na ba' na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Jerobaal gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim bhaan gu Abimelek xibhɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan gu chichio'ñ gu Sikêm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu noobh na ba' kooda' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Sikêm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu kakkavɨk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Abimelek.
Jano' ba' gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed suudai' u'va bɨɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Sikêm; gio ba' gu Sikêm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' gamai' yooxi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' baakɨk vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios koi'mɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Abimelek.

Ba' jix aa' gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed; gio ba' chɨkka gu Abimelek guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Sikêm na ba' no'ch guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham gu mar gu Jerobaal cham gu Sebul guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Serbid gu chio'ñ gu emor gu taat gu Sikêm; gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dua'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix maa dhi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Abimelek; gio ba' chɨtda gu Abimelek; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Sebul guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kiicham tɨiñ gu ñi'ook gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' bhañ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix duu gu Abimelek bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap gu Sikêm guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mia'n kiicham bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' bamii' jano' gu tukaa' tu' gu ja'tkam bɨndak guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ yooxi'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tas tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kiicham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan tu' jix duu bɨɨx bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu tukaa' gu Abimelek bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't jix dhaas guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan gu Sikêm bɨɨx maakobh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed jix buus jix dhaas ba'k ki'ñgob kiicham; gio ba' gu Abimelek bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't jix búup guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Gaal gu ja'tkam gu Sebul; gio ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu kakkavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Sebul jix aa'; jano' ba' ɨkgiga'n gu kakkavɨk tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Gaal guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ñiokda'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jupaabkamu'n gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam gu Meonenim.

Jano' ba' gu Sebul jix aa'; gio ba' duukat jano' mii' dhɨr ñiokda' bham; mi' dhɨr chɨkka gu Abimelek na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham dhi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Sal jano' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Gaal jix buus vupui bhaan gu Sikêm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Abimelek.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abimelek vupui bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' ia'rɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mui'x bɨɨx ka'm ba'k ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu Abimelek guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Aruma; gio ba' gu Sebul guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mai' gu Gaal gu ja'tkam na ba' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Sikêm.
Jano' ba' ka't buimgidhak gu tanoolh gu ja'tkam jix buus yooxi'; gio ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Abimelek.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vaik guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix dhaas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga yooxi'; gio ba' na ja'p tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam busaak kiicham; mi' dhɨr jix búup bhaan tu' naaka'n.

Na gu' gu Abimelek guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim ba'k ki'ñgob kiicham; gio ba' gook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx mi'p yooxi' jix duu.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Abimelek kiicham bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kiicham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhi' bɨx mi'p bhi'ñbak gu Sikêm baap gu kavɨk vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Berit.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Abimelek na ja'p bɨx bhi'ñbak gu Sikêm mi'p guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Abimelek gu kavɨk gu Salmoon bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abimelek guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu u'u guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bham gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ja'p tu'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gio maa'n guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhiadat gu Abimelek jix dhaas ju'ñdharan gu kavɨk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tai bɨɨx gu kavɨk; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx bhi'ñbak gu Sikêm jix koko' na ja'p mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Abimelek ka't gu Tebes; gio ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Tebes jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr kiicham ka't bhi'ñbak jix kavɨk tu jiim bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ bɨx gu Jawatan kiicham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhi'ñbak.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Abimelek bhi'ñbak guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ki'ñgob bhi'ñbak na ba' jix duu gu tai.

Gu' gu' gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan mo'o gu Abimelek guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt kutun kavɨk; na gu' jix buusñi gu kuchii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu'; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; jano' ba' kutun kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix koi.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Israelitas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix koi gu Abimelek jix bɨɨx duu maa'n gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios gu Abimelek cham bhai' bhaan gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx cham bhai' gu chichio'ñ gu Sikêm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ɨɨbhidham; gio ba' mu'ai gu Jotam gu mar gu Jerobaal suudai' u'va bhaan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Abimelek jix búup na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Israeel gu Tola gu mar gu Puua gu mar gu Dodo gu chio'ñ gu Issakâr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Samir gu kavɨk gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix koi ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Samir.
Jano' ba' bhaan jix búup gu Jair gu Galaadita guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ buur ko'kmarak guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jair bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Jair ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Kamoon.

Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Baales gu Astarot gu Jawatan Dios gu Siria gu Jawatan Dios gu Sidoon gu Jawatan Dios gu Moab gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Jawatan Dios gu Pilisteos; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim bhaan gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu novɨ gu Pilisteos gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi'p baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Amorreo gu Galaad.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jordaan na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gio bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Judaa bhaan gu Benjamiin gu vaak gu Epraim; gio ba' ka't gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' no'ch guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ uañi'ñ bhaan tu'; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨtda:―Cha'pim chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Baales.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Ejipto gu Amorreos gu Ammonitas gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gu Sidoon gu Amalek gu Maoon jiiñkɨk tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu noobh.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ duuñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn namkidhat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu vupui tu' bɨɨx no'ch na ja'p xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kuiñcha tu jiim gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Galaad; gio ba' jum daa'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Mispa.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu ja'tkam gu Galaad gui'p maa'n; gio ba' chɨkka ka't kua'da' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ka't mo'o bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jano' ba' gu Jeptee gu Galaadita gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk gu mar ganai' ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Galaad.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Galaad gio ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam; na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mai' gu Jeptee tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu taat na gu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jeptee kuiñcha gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha' gu Tob; gio ba' jum daa'ñ bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jix duu bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ko'kmarak bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Israeel daraa gu Galaad jix bɨɨx duu na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jeptee gu oidha' gu Tob.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Jeptee; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka' chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' gu Jeptee jix aa' daraa gu Galaad; na pai' dhuuk cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu taat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jano' tu' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' daraa gu Galaad tu ñi'ook gu Jeptee; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' kuiñcha guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jano' tu' na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx no'ch guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mo'o bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Galaad.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeptee jano' ba' daraa gu Galaad; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' mo'o.
Jano' ba' daraa gu Galaad tu ñi'ook gu Jeptee; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch tu' cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jeptee suudai' u'va bɨɨx daraa gu Galaad gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mo'o gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jeptee tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jeptee guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Ammonitas bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨbiap tu' na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ammonitas jix aa' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jeptee; na pai' dhuuk na gu' gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto dɨr gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Jabok gu Jordaan; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jano' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jeptee guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨip guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Ammonitas.
Na ba' na ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jeptee tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel cham jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' gu Moab tu' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel gu Ejipto jix jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Kades.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Israeel bhañ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Edom bham; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha'; gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Edom cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; jano' ba' bhañ gio gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Israeel gu Kades.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jiimchu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' gu Edom pai' gu Moab bai'ñpu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ pai' gu Moab guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' dhi' baasɨ'n gu Arnoon cham baap guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' gu Moab; na gu' gu Arnoon pai' gu Moab.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Israeel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm pai'.

Gu' gu' gu Seoon cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Israeel na ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha'; gio ba' va'k guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Seoon bɨx gu ja'tkam jix dhaas yooxi' gu Jaas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Israeel.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel do'ñcho gu Seoon bɨx gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel bɨx gu oidha' gu Amorreo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gio bɨx gu oidha' gu Amorreo dɨr gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Jabok dɨr oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm gu Jordaan.
Na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Amorreos vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Kêmos gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios oi'ñdha' cham bia'ka' tu' bia'ka' no'ch bɨx mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu' jano' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tutkɨ gu Balak gu mar gu Sepor gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu Israeel bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Israeel tu' dhi' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu esboon taañpu' gu Aroer taañpu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Arnoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na ba' tu' cham tu' uañi'ñ bhaan tu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jir bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jeptee bhañ.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Jeptee; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Galaad gu Manasees; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Mispa gu Galaad; jano' ba' gu Mispa gu Galaad guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jeptee guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tu' kɨɨsa' gu Ammonitas gu noobh.

Na pai' dhuuk no'x guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kiki'ñgob gu vaak na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Ammonitas bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan.
