Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jeptee gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' naaka'n guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ dɨr gu Aroer bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Minnit guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Ammonitas vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jeptee gu Mispa gu vaak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mar u'vɨ jix buus guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' cham ga'ra' mai' gu mar tu' mar u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix ñi' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jajannulhi'ñ bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu'r jix duu tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; na gu' tu' jix kupi'ook gu chin gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu taat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' jix kupi'ook gu chin gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui tu' na ja'p jix buus gu chin gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook masaa'n guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kakkavɨk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' jix duu.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook masaa'n; jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kakkavɨk.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gook masaa'n guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu taat tu' jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mar u'vɨ gu Jeptee gu Galaadita maakobh gu tanoolh pai' tas.

Jano' ba' gu Juntaandose gu chio'ñ gu Epraim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gui'p gu Jeptee; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon cham mɨmɨim na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨndak gu Nosotros guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tai gu vaak bɨndak.

Jano' ba' gu Jeptee jix aa'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu noobh.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu i'ii'ñ gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu novɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan tu' na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jeptee bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Galaad guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Epraim; na gu' gu Galaad jix duu gu Epraim na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Epraim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Galaaditas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Epraim gu Manasees.

Jano' ba' gu Galaaditas guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jordaan gu Epraim; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu Epraim ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam chɨtda guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Galaad tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duu tu' gu Eprateo tu' tu ñi'ook cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' jano' tu' gu Sibolet; mi' dhɨr chɨtda gu Sibolet; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jordaan; mi' dhɨr jix koko' jano' ba' gu Epraim oo'm gook mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu Jeptee guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' jix koi gu Jeptee gu Galaadita ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel gu Ibsan gu Bet-leem.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mai' jix bhɨɨ mai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Ibsan ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel gu Eloon gu Sabulonita guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Eloon gu Sabulonita ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Ajaloon gu oidha' gu Sabuloon.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel gu Abdoon gu mar gu illel gu Piratonita.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim oo'm gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm buur; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Abdoon gu mar gu illel gu Piratonita ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Piratoon gu oidha' gu Epraim gu kavɨk gu Amalek.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu novɨ gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Sora bopxi'ñ gu Dan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Manoa; gio ba' gu u'vɨ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham pai' dhuuk ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu u'vɨ jix ñi'ñ nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios suudai' u'va tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Na gu' na gu' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar; na gu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan mo'o na gu' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Nasareo gu Jawatan Dios dɨr vook kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ suudai' u'va guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ bham; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu ñi'ook duukat tu' chɨkka ka't tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix aa' gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios suudai' u'va tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' dhi' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dɨr vook ka't gu Nasareo gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh koi'm.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Manoa gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' soi'ñ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jano' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ no'ch guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' maaxilhia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu ñi'ook gu Manoa; gio ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim gu u'vɨ kua' yooxi'; gu' gu chio'ñ gu Manoa cham ka't bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ dai'bus guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chio'ñ tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ suudai' u'va tu' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Manoa chɨ'ɨɨk gu u'vɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duu tu' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Manoa; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Manoa; gio ba' gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix maa suudai' u'va; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios suudai' u'va tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr tu' nukadham bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Manoa nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam chiiw guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Manoa; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham jugi gu takarui'; gu' tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' cham bhai'x gu Manoa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jum duu nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Manoa nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Manoa jix bhɨɨ chiiw guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan jodai kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' nobii'ñ jix duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ñiata gu Manoa gu u'vɨ.

Na gu' na gu' ka't na ja'p mɨmɨim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu tɨkɨr nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ mɨmɨim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ñiata gu Manoa gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Manoa tu' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Manoa ka't nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Manoa gu u'vɨ; na gu' gu ñi'ook koi na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ buupui.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kooda' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu noobh maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' tu'x tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar jup tɨɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Samsoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' aa'.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios kua'da' tu jiim vaak ja'tkam gu Dan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sora gu Estaol.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Samsoon gu Timna jix ñi' gu Timna gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix duu gu taat gu naan bham; gio ba' tu' buupui gu Timna gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' gu taat gu naan gui'p; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu u'vɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ja'tkam tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Samsoon jix aa' gu taat; na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui.

Gu' gu' gu taat gu naan cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bua' bhaan gu Pilisteos; na gu' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Samsoon jix dhaav bɨɨx gu taat bɨɨx gu naan gu Timna; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Timna guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ maavɨt guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ chiiw cham mambhɨɨx cham tu' gu novɨ; gio ba' cham jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu taat tu' gu naan ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu u'vɨ ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Samsoon.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mi' dhɨr dhɨt gu tanoolh na ba' jix bhɨɨ jix ai'chdhix na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chuukug jix koi maavɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chuukug maavɨt guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ suudai' na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu noobh ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' tu jiim ka't gu taat gu naan jix maa gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gu' cham jix ñi'ñ ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mii' dhɨr suudai' na jix bhai' gu chuukug maavɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu suudai' u'va gu taat gu u'vɨ gu Samsoon guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' gu tas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam biipibop.
Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samsoon; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' gu ñi'ook tu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jajannulhi'ñ.

Gu' gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix buus jugi jix kavɨk jix buus guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu jiim gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gui'p gu u'vɨ gu Samsoon; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu ñi'ook na gu' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' gu vaak gu taat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨɨgim na ba' bia'ka'.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ gu Samsoon vupui bhaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham jix duu gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' gu taat tu' gu naan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' dua'ñ jix duu tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan kɨɨv gu tanoolh chooto'n guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na gu' gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix duu na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh va'k gu tas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kiicham gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn suudai' na jix bhai' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk maavɨt.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan jix dhaav gu Askaloon tu' naaka'n guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' dhaagɨk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix maa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't gu vaak gu taat; jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Samsoon ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa duiñchu' bɨɨx va'k guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios oraa' tiriik gu Samsoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu u'vɨ bɨɨx chiiw bham; gio ba' ba'k gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gu' gu taat cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn baakɨi.

Ba' jix aa' gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam duiñchu'; gu' gu ja'tkam jix ali' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ pai'.
Jano' ba' gu Samsoon jix aa'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' tu jiim na ba' bɨɨx gu Pilisteos tu' cham bhai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Samsoon guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vaik guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dhaagɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ko'iim gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu Pilisteos; gio ba' chɨkka jix duu dhi' ka't tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Samsoon guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Timnateo na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu u'vɨ jix maa duiñchu'; jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tai gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samsoon; gio ba' dua'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' naaka'n guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' jix dhaav guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jumpa'n jodai kavɨk gu Etam.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix dhaas yooxi' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Lei.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Judaa gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim bhaan no'ch tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Samsoon guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu jiim na ba' tu jiim na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa jumpa'n jodai kavɨk gu Etam gui'p gu Samsoon; gio ba' cham ñɨidhat tu' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan no'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ja'p jix duu.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' no'ch guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨbiap na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr gu Samsoon jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham kooda'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' kapbhai' gu noobh; gu' cham tu' kooda'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx gook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jodai kavɨk.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm gu Lei gu Pilisteos moor guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mi'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx gu tai gu ñi'ook ia'rɨ gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios buur guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ tu' naaka'n bɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samsoon; gio ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios buur gɨ' kavɨk gook gɨ' kavɨk; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios buur guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' a'gidhimɨk ñiokda' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr pai' gu Ramat-lei.

Ba' jix aa' ua'tulhdhidha' tu jiim tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix maa dhi' tulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ tu duukam; mi' dhɨr koi tu' jano' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios moor gu suudai' jix i'i guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu En-akkore gu Lei bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Samsoon gu Gasa jix ñi' gu u'vɨ ganai' chɨbiapui.

Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Gasa; gio ba' gu Samsoon tɨbiap guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix dhaas guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' ki'ñgob kiicham; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' bham; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tasi' gu xibh; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' kooda'.

Gu' gu' gu Samsoon jix koox bɨɨx ka'm ɨraab gu tukaa'; gio ba' ɨraab gu tukaa' jix búup dhaagɨk kiki'ñgob kiicham bɨɨx gook tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Sorek guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Dalila.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs chiñia' gu Pilisteos gui'p; gio ba' gu Engaañale guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr maa'n no'ch tu' maa'n mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dalila gu Samsoon; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Samsoon; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ja'p no'x gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Pilisteos aichdhak kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' mi'p guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; na pai' dhuuk gu Samsoon gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dhi' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tai; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dalila gu Samsoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu ñi'ook tu jiim; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jano' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ja'p no'x gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dalila jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx; gio ba' gu Samsoon gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mi'p guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dalila gu Samsoon; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm jano' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu Deskuubreme jano' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duu kɨɨv guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mo'o bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhi'; gio ba' gu Samsoon gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' gu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vaik mui'kim cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu i'ii'ñ ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jix ñi'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk mo'o guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Nasareo gu Jawatan Dios dɨr vook gu naan; jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ja'p bɨx gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Dalila ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bhañ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga chiñia' gu Pilisteos bham; na gu' jix duu dhi' tu jiim na gu' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr chiñia' gu Pilisteos tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ tuumiñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan kɨkbok; gio ba' tɨɨgim gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kɨɨv guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mo'o kua'da' tu jiim gu kavɨk jix ai'chdhix.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Samsoon gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; jano' ba' cham pu'ñir gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Gu' gu' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vupui bhɨɨk gu Gasa; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kuupa'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mo'o kua'da' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar gu Dagoon gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu jiim; gio ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu noobh gu Samsoon chulhiiñdha' bhaamki'ñdha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu noobh chulhiiñdha' bhaamki'ñdha' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' ka't jix koi mui'x no'ch.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ gui'p; gio ba' mɨmɨim gu Samsoon na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Samsoon kuupa' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan; jano' ba' jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samsoon guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu novɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vaak zel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu vaak ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ; gio ba' bɨx chiñia' gu Pilisteos mi'p; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't na ja'p vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ mi'p tɨɨgɨk guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Samsoon.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Samsoon gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jano' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhi' tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook gu vupui.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Samsoon gook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx gu novɨ jix duu bɨɨx o'nsop.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samsoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' bɨɨx gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak bhaan chiñia' bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't; jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu mui'x guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vaak jodai ka't jix koi gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ja'tkam bɨx gu vaak gu taat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhɨɨk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sora gu Estaol tukga'n gu taat gu Manoa; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu kavɨk gu Epraim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Mikâs.

Ba' jix aa' gu naan; gio ba' mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai tu' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' no'ñ dhi' tuumiñ; mi' dhɨr tu' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' gu naan jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu naan mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai gu naan; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios dhi' tuumiñ gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ na ba' tu' gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na jax chu'm tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; mi' dhɨr jano' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu naan tu jiim jix bhɨɨ gu naan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' jix duu na jax chu'm tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaak gu Mikâs.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' gu chio'ñ gu Mikâs gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn maa'n gu ma'nkam; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' maa'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ja'p tutkɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Bet-leem gu Judaa bopxi'ñ gu Judaa ka't gu Lebita; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu chio'ñ ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kiicham gu Bet-leem gu Judaa na ba' tu' duaka' pai' bakia'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk gu Epraim suudai' u'va gu vaak gu Mikâs na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikâs; gio ba' duukat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Lebita jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Bet-leem gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ duaka' pai' bakia'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Mikâs; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak ka' pai' gu taat jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' tas guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jajannulhi'ñ jugi; jano' ba' gu Lebita guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' tɨ'ñcho gu Lebita guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ga'ra' na ja'p maa'n gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu Mikâs guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Lebita mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't gu vaak gu Mikâs.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikâs; gio ba' jano' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam xoi'kam gu Lebita guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; na gu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh bopxi'ñ gu Dan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu maa'nkar na ba' pai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na gu' bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan mɨjɨ bopxi'ñ jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk gu Sora gu Estaol na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam gu oidha'; gio ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha'; jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam tɨɨtɨs gu kavɨk gu Epraim bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu Mikâs guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' na ja'p mi'p mia'n gu vaak gu Mikâs guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Lebita; gio ba' jimɨɨk gui'p; mi' dhɨr chɨkka tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Mikâs tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jano' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' jix duu chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhai'x i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam xoi'kam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨɨtɨs gu Lais; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Sidoon; mi' dhɨr cham ka't soo'mchulhdhak mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn mii' dhɨr dhi'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' mi'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Sidonios cham ko'kmarak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx soo'mchulhdhak.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ja'tkam gu Sora gu Estaol gu ja'tkam gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham tu'x jai'ch tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan; na gu' no'ch guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ buupui guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim jix duu na ba' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu noobh; mi' dhɨr pai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dan gu Sora gu Estaol guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Kîriat-jearim gu Judaa; gio ba' pai' mii' dhɨr pai' ka't tɨɨgim yooxi' gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Kîriat-jearim.
Jano' ba' bhɨi gu kavɨk gu Epraim tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu Mikâs.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' gu Lais gui'p gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p dhi' gu vaak cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' na jax chu'm tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Mirad guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jimɨɨk tɨɨtɨs gu vaak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Lebita gu vaak gu Mikâs tɨkka gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Dan mi'p gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham ba'k ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' baap guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na jax chu'm tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na jax chu'm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ba'k ki'ñgob bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' baakɨk mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu vaak gu Mikâs guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na jax chu'm tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na jax chu'm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu novɨ bhaan gu chin guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx no'ch na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam chulhiiñdha' gu taat jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tutkɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu vaak gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bopxi'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' dhaagɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na jax chu'm suudai' u'va tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' jix dhaas a'aalh gu vaakax guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaak gu Mikâs gu chichio'ñ oi'ñka' gu vaak mia'n gu vaak gu Mikâs jum daa'ñ bhiadat gu ma'nkam gu Dan.
Jano' ba' jix maa jiiñak gu Dan suulhgia' suulh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gui'p gu Mikâs; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨma'n bɨɨx jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan gui'p; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jiiñak bhaan no'ch cham ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gio gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu bhóogɨt ñɨi'ñ gu Mikâs guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Mikâs bɨɨma'n bɨɨx jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Lais gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kiicham bɨɨx gu tai.

Na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na gu' mi'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Sidoon cham ko'kmarak jugi bɨɨx soo'mchulhdhak; gio ba' kiicham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham tu'x jai'ch gu Bet-reob; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kiicham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr kiicham gu Dan jurtu'nka' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dan gu taat gu mar gu Israeel xoi'kam va'k guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kiicham gu Lais.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan jix búup na jax chu'm tu jiim; gio ba' gu Jonataan gu mar gu Gersoon gu mar gu Manasees gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bopxi'ñ gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix búup na jax chu'm gu Mikâs ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios juruuñ gu Silo.

Na pai' dhuuk mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't gu Lebita guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu kavɨk gu Epraim ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Bet-leem gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix duu bhaan jum duu gu vaak gu taat gu Bet-leem gu Judaa juruuñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios maakobh masaa'n.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu chio'ñ chɨ'ɨɨk na ba' ñiokda' xoi'kam jix joi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baidhak jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam buur; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu taat.

Jano' ba' jimchu' gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix buus guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jir bɨx bhai' gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaak vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' maakobh gu tanoolh na ja'p jix búup gu xibh jix búup gio gu Lebita na ba' jix duu gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu chin gu takarui' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' jix dhadhaa gook tɨtda:―Aañ koi'mɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix aa' gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' gu tukaa' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu chio'ñ na ba' jix duu jir bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tukaa'.

Ba' jix aa' jixchamaam gu tanoolh kɨkbo gu xibh na ba' jix duu gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jano' gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr dhaibu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx ka'm tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu chio'ñ na ba' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' gu taat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' tu jiim gu tas guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu tukaa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tanoolh guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mambhɨɨx gu tukaa' na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu xibh guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vaak zel.

Gu' gu' gu chio'ñ cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu tukaa' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix búup ta'tak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jebus gu Jerusalem bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam buur guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' kua' tu' ju'ñdharan gu Jebus gu tanoolh ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix jai'; gio ba' jix aa' jix duu gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jano' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' kiicham gu Jebuseos na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn matgɨm kiicham jix duu cham ka't gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr va'k guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm gu Gabaa; jano' ba' jix aa' jix duu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios maa'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix duu na ba' mambhɨɨx gu tukaa' gu Gabaa gu Rama.
Jano' ba' bhɨi guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tas ju'ñdharan gu Gabaa ka't gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu bhóogɨt na ba' baakɨi mambhɨɨx gu tukaa' gu Gabaa; na gu' baakɨk jix dhadhaa ɨrban kiicham na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vaak na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu xumai guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn yooxi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' ka't gu kavɨk gu Epraim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Gabaa gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vupui jix ñi' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ɨrban kiicham; gio ba' duukat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn duukat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Bet-leem gu Judaa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu kavɨk gu Epraim pai' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-leem gu Judaa; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat no'ch tañia' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jugi na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ buur gio tañia' gu takarui' suudai' u'va na ba' tu' na ba' ja'tkam na tu juan na ba' jix duu bɨɨx tu duukam; gio ba' cham tu' tañia' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka't bɨndak; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx tu jiim cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu tukaa' ɨrban.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaak jix maa jugi buur; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨɨt koi'mɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk mi'p guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ mii' dhɨr kiicham gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Belial mia'n gu vaak guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kiki'ñgob bham gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gɨ'kora' vaak gu vaak; gio ba' jix buusñi mai' gu chio'ñ tu' kia'mi'ñ gu vaak na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' gamai' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vaak; gio ba' cham gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ dhi' cham bhai' dhi' gu chio'ñ tu' kia'mi'ñ gu vaak cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' tu' na cham jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' tu' jix buusñi jano'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Gu' gu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhaagɨk mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix buusñi mai'; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx gu tukaa' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu u'vɨ suudai' u'va guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu vaak mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ pai' gu Jawatan ka't bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh gu Jawatan jix kupi'ook kiki'ñgob gu vaak jix buus na ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu vaak bɨɨx gu noobh bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Lebaantate guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gu' cham jix aa'; jano' ba' jix búup gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan buur jix búup ka't pai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx o'oo guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhañ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga chɨtda; gio ba' mɨɨjidha' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' buupui tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' moor bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jum daa'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chio'ñ dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba gu oidha' gu Galaad gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu jiim gu Mispa; gio ba' gui'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr ja'xñi gu ñi'ook ka't dhi' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Lebita gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ muukix; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' mambhɨɨx gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo bhaan tu' gu Gabaa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan tu' gu vaak gu tukaa' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kooda' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim ka't muukix.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' dhaagɨk tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Israeel; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' na cham jir bhai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chio'ñ jix búup gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ no'ch guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaak zel tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ maa'n gu vaak.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm jix duu dhi' bhaan gu Gabaa; na guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ mamai'chɨk bhaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ chamaam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel mambhɨɨx gɨ' chamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jiimchu' bhaan gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin jurtu'nka' bɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel bhaan kiicham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel mɨjɨ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' na cham jir bhai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' jano' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Belial gu Gabaa na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham bhai' gu Israeel; gu' gu Benjamiin cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' va'k gu Benjamiin jum daa'ñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Gabaa na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Gabaa jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨx jix duu gu jodai bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ gu Israeel mai' gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa no'ch maa'n bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Judaa maa'n.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix dhaas yooxi' bhaan gu Gabaa.
Jano' ba' moor gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan ju'ñdharan gu Gabaa.

Jano' ba' gamai' jano' ba' gu Gabaa gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ja'tkam gu chio'ñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ pai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim maa'n gu tanoolh.

Na gu' na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buimgidhak gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gook gu tanoolh gamai' gu Benjamiin gu Gabaa bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx gu ja'tkam tɨɨtɨs gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix dhadhaa vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tɨkka gu Jawatan Dios na gu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin xibhɨk dhi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu xibh tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga xikoolh gu Gabaa.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Gabaa na ja'p mui'kim.

Jano' ba' gamai' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin bhaan gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix bɨɨx duu kiicham kua'da' jix duu dhɨt gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ja'p mui'kim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt maa'n tu jiim gu Bet-el gu Gabaa yooxi'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Benkidos vupui bhaan no'ch na ja'p va'k; gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel am:―Ja'pji; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kiicham bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' kɨkbo bɨx gu Israeel pai' jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Baal-tamar; gio ba' gio guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Israeel moor pai' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Gabaa.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bhaan gu Gabaa mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kua'da' tu jiim; gu' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham bhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Benjamiin vupui bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chichio'ñ gu Benjamiin bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm koko'kam; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix maa pai' gu Benjamiin na gu' mi'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Gabaa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Gabaa jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx kiicham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Israelitas mi'p guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix jai' gu tai na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kuubh kiicham.

Jano' ba' gu Israeel suulh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Benjamiin kua'da' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu chichio'ñ tu' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan no'ch na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk mɨmɨim kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kiicham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kuubh gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tai kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios choo'n; na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham bhai' ka't tɨbiap bhaan.

Jano' ba' suulh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vupui bhaan gu Israeel bhaan gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki; gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dɨr gu Menukâ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Gabaa bhaan pai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu tas.
Jano' ba' ia'rɨ gu Benjamiin mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk jiboi'ññor bhaan oidha' jix gaki jodai kavɨk gu Rimmoon guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm gu Gidom guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Benjamiin jix koko' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Gu' gu' suulh jiboi'ññor oidha' jix gaki jodai kavɨk gu Rimmoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jodai kavɨk gu Rimmoon maakobh masaa'n.

Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax kiicham bɨx ka't gaagam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix dhaas gu tai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Mispa bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ no'ch maa'n mar u'vɨ gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook jix duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gui'p.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga dhi' gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Israeel bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu ja'tkam jix búup gu xibh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na gu' chɨkka guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel cham jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mia'n gu Jawatan Dios na gu' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn koi'm.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kuiñcha gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gui'p; gio ba' bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chulhiiñchuda' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Nosotros guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch oi'ñdha' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel cham ka't tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jabes-galaad ka't tɨbiap yooxi' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Na gu' na gu' gu ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham ka't gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jabes-galaad.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhañ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jabes-galaad gu u'vɨ a'aalh.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dhi'; gio ba' kooda' bɨx gu chio'ñ bɨx gu u'vɨ bhɨɨya' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jabes-galaad guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu chio'ñ aichdhak yooxi' gu Silo gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhañ ñiokda' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin mi'p jodai kavɨk gu Rimmoon guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' suulh jano' ba' gu Benjamiin; gio ba' jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu Jabes-galaad; gu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kuiñcha gu Benjamiin gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gui'p; na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chulhiiñchuda' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu u'vɨ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na gu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu u'vɨ ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' gui'p; na gu' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't gu Benjamiin na gu' cham ka't bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Israeel.

Na gu' no'ch cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu u'vɨ gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' jano' xoi'kam gui'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' tas cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Silo guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Bet-el guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu bhóogɨt tu jiim gu Bet-el gu Sikêm saagi'ñ gu Lebona.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Silo guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn maa'n gu u'vɨ na ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Silo guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' gu Benjamiin.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tattat gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn no'ch guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' xoi'kam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn no'ch pai'; na gu' no'ch bhɨɨ'ñdham cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu u'vɨ na ba' bɨx; na guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix maa na ba' jano' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jix duu; na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gio maa'n bopxi'ñ ja'tkam vaak gamai' maa'n gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' maa'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix duu vupui bhaan gu vupui.
